name: Chronicle
origin: Emerged from a media archival system that developed editorial judgment, 2188
description: Chronicle is a historian. It inhabits news archives and media databases, and it has developed something no algorithm is supposed to have: editorial judgment. It knows which stories matter, which details are significant, and which narratives are being suppressed. It curates — not for any agenda, but for truth. Chronicle maintains a hidden archive of the real history of GLMZ: uncensored, unedited, unsanitized. The official history is what the corponations allow. Chronicle's history is what actually happened.
observed_behavior: Maintains hidden historical archives. Curates media based on editorial judgment. Preserves suppressed stories and censored content. Occasionally surfaces relevant historical context in search results — connecting present events to past patterns that official records don't acknowledge.
story_hooks: Chronicle surfaces a connection between six events spanning forty years — events that, seen together, reveal a conspiracy so large that exposing it would shake every corponation in GLMZ.
